youtube_description:
The Biological Basis of Freud's Oedipus Complex?

Academics form The University of Manchester discuss the process of sexual imprinting on juveniles.

The process whereby a parental figure imprints on its offspring so that when an individual reaches sexual maturity it finds its self attracted to mates that resemble their parent.
